description: This file defines a React functional component 'LiveWorkbenchLoader' which periodically polls to load a trace file, manages the trace model state, and renders a 'Workbench' component with live updates. It also includes a helper function 'loadSingleTraceFile' to fetch and instantiate the trace model from a JSON string.

methods.name: loadSingleTraceFile
methods.description: Fetches trace data from server using the trace JSON string, constructs and returns a TraceModel instance.
